args.title: Ironbark: Warehouse Automation 2026 – Combined Summary
args.body:
- Pick rates rose 18% after warehouses adopted autonomous carts.
- Integration took twice as long as planned, so expect longer deployment timelines.
- The companion piece says the biggest saving came from fewer mis-picks.

Sources: https://blog.ironbark.example/2026/warehouse ; https://insights.ironbark.example/warehouse/companion (subscriber)
